checkpoints.name: Project Setup
checkpoints.scope: Create the feature branch, add baseline scaffolding, document conventions in docs/implementation_plan.md.
exit_criteria: Feature branch exists and is checked out
checkpoints.review_notes: Approved. Branch created and plan documented.

checkpoints.name: Implement Core Module
checkpoints.scope: Build the main feature module per the plan. Include unit tests.
exit_criteria: Unit tests cover the public API
npm run lint reports no issues
checkpoints.review_notes: Built. Files added: src/feature/*, tests/feature/*. Awaiting reviewer.

checkpoints.name: Wire Into App
checkpoints.scope: Expose the new module through the app entry point and add an integration test.
exit_criteria: App starts with the new module enabled
Integration test covers the end-to-end happy path
